summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan for AuraNovel:
1. Cyber-Aura premium aesthetic overhaul matching reference project VID_f55928cf.zip (glassmorphism, gradient accents, glowing badges, dark neon palette).
2. Discover & Explore hub with trending/popular carousels, category pills, and multi-source global search.
3. Reading History timeline with chronological grouping (Today, Yesterday, Earlier), progress bars, and instant 'Continue' reading action.
4. Robust Extension Repository Engine supporting NovelSourcery index.pb / index.min.json manifests and Mihon/LNReader community repos.
5. Universal Document Reader supporting EPUB, PDF, CBZ/CBR, TXT, Markdown, and HTML with high-performance Jetpack Compose rendering.
